# Microsoft etl2pcapng

This directory contains the Microsoft etl2pcapng v1.11.0 Windows x64 release and its MIT license. The Windows application extracts the converter into the capture directory when using Netsh.

The SHA-256 of the release executable is
`c2d03aac43ea0f5626fc8d909e6688393feaf71bd6facd39aaf8a637382d9043`.

[Microsoft release and original source](https://github.com/microsoft/etl2pcapng/releases/tag/v1.11.0)
